answer: Give each identity one tended plot in a shared orchard of verifiable work: it locks 110 POA for 45 days and must deliver 12 distinct audited outputs, one every three days, each stamped with a quartz-hard hash of unique compute. A second identity needs a second plot, 220 POA, and 12 fresh outputs, a third 440 POA, so capital and labour double per fake. Auditors spot-check outputs against the ledger and slash 35% of linked stakes for duplicates; only identities reaching the zenith of 12 clean outputs earn rewards.
